claude.note: Tiers are listed lightest first. Every new task names its tier with --tier; choose the lightest one that does the task as well as the top one. light, standard and complex run at xhigh effort. frontier runs Claude Fable 5.2, the strongest model, at high effort by default; --effort medium is its only other choice, and it never runs above high.

light.use: mechanical and lookup work: running tests or gates and reporting, reproducing a bug, inventories and summaries, renames and other mechanical edits, gathering facts from given files

standard.use: well-specified, bounded work: small changes with clear done criteria, tests for existing behavior, docs, reviews of small diffs

complex.use: hard or high-risk work: several modules, an unsettled approach, costly or subtle mistakes, a large unfamiliar subsystem, a large or risky review, a failed lighter attempt; every pull-request babysitter

frontier.use: difficult or long tasks: long-horizon or unattended multi-step work, changes across many modules with an unsettled design, hard debugging or root-cause analysis, large or high-risk reviews and audits, a complex attempt that failed. Fable 5.2 beats Opus 5.5 and Codex astra on agentic coding and keeps going until a long job is done; at high effort it matches Opus's best at about half the cost per task. --effort high (default) or medium for long but less hard work, never above

codex.note: Tiers are listed lightest first; choose the lightest one that does the task as well as the top one. Simple work (lookups, test runs, inventories) goes to luna or terra; difficult work to astra, or to Claude frontier when it is also long.

light.use: work with nothing to judge: running tests or gates and reporting, lookups, inventories and summaries, reproducing a bug from given steps, mechanical edits

standard.use: well-specified, bounded coding: small changes with clear done criteria, tests for existing behavior, lint or type fixes, reviews of small diffs

strong.use: bounded work that needs more judgment: live web research, reviews of medium diffs, debugging in a known area, a standard attempt that failed. Near-astra quality at a lower cost

complex.use: hard or high-risk work: several modules, an unsettled approach, costly or subtle mistakes, a large unfamiliar subsystem, a large or risky review, a failed strong attempt

rankNote: rank is how strong a tier's model is, on one scale for both agents. A delegated task may start tasks at its own rank or lower, never higher (start refuses it).
